env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The model learns to write to and read from files on demand—using the file system not just as storage, but as structured, externalized memory.
env_context_strategy.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Use the File System as Context

context_compaction.evidence_quote: the content of a web page can be dropped from the context as long as the URL is preserved, and a document's contents can be omitted if its path remains available in the sandbox
context_compaction.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Use the File System as Context
context_compaction.note: Restorable compression of observations. Other mechanisms are not described.

observation_format.evidence_quote: That action is then executed in the environment (e.g., Manus's virtual machine sandbox) to produce an observation.
observation_format.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Design Around the KV-Cache
observation_format.note: Observation modality is not specified; the browser tools could imply other formats.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: the output—usually a structured function call—remains relatively short
tool_call_format.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Design Around the KV-Cache
tool_call_format.note: Hermes-format tool_call prefill is described as an example.

tool_count.note: The tool list is not disclosed; only browser_ and shell_ prefixes are mentioned.

edit_primitive.note: No edit tool definition is available.

tool_schema_source.note: No schema source is given. MCP is mentioned only in general terms.

protocol_standardization.note: MCP is discussed generically; it is not stated that Manus implements it.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The action and observation are appended to the context, forming the input for the next iteration. This loop continues until the task is complete.
loop_primitives.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Design Around the KV-Cache

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: it tends to create a todo.md file—and update it step-by-step as the task progresses, checking off completed items
planning_granularity.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Manipulate Attention Through Recitation

short_term_state.evidence_quote: By constantly rewriting the todo list, Manus is reciting its objectives into the end of the context.
short_term_state.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Manipulate Attention Through Recitation
short_term_state.note: A context-aware state machine also exists for tool masking.

long_term_memory.note: File memory is described within a task; cross-run persistence is not stated.

retry_policy.note: The post argues against hiding errors via retry, but the task-level policy is not stated.

termination_condition.note: The post says only "until the task is complete"; the mechanism is not described.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: KV-cache hit rate is the single most important metric for a production-stage AI agent
cost_controls.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Design Around the KV-Cache

execution_isolation.evidence_locator: paper Sec. Design Around the KV-Cache

permission_model.evidence_quote: Manus uses a context-aware state machine to manage tool availability. Rather than removing tools, it masks the token logits during decoding
permission_model.note: Closest value: this state machine constrains which actions may be chosen, but it is not a safety authorisation mechanism.
